name: 32110 · Bunnell, FL
findings: ZIP 32110 (Bunnell) has 38 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32110 (Bunnell) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 32110 (Bunnell) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 53% of all organizations here have no identified type.
